notes.title: Sweet Home Puzzle 1.0.3 released
notes.content:
Another update is here, and brings some big performance optimizations!

Optimization:


Added a new launch option for low end pcs which allows to change the rendering path and increases performance. You can either use the newly steam 2nd launch option that appears when you launch the game through your library or add the "-FeatureLevelES31" flag to your launch parameters.


To view all patch notes, heads here.

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Sweet Home Puzzle 1.0.2 released
notes.content:
Here we are again with another update.

New features:


You can now rotate a piece without selecting it before.


QoL changes:


When you have the options book open, you can now hit Escape to close it.


Bugfixes:


Dropdowns in the options book and input bindings are now translated and update on language change.
Fixed some typos in puzzle descriptions.


To view all patch notes, heads here.

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Sweet Home Puzzle 1.0.1 released
notes.content:
One month since game release yet, and here we are with our first update.

New features:


Hide ingame HUD: you can now completely hide the ingame HUD (except box list of course). You must bind a key to the new "Toggle ingame HUD" control option and then enjoy less on-screen clutter.
Customizable background color: don't like that default brown background? No problem! You can now change the background color ingame to any color you whish! Just go in the general options and use the new color picker to make the background your own.


QoL changes:


Slightly increased snap distance to avoid the frustation of having to pixel-perfect align puzzle parts in order to snap them together.


Bugfixes:


If the action of rotating a part was set on RightMouseButton (which is the default binding); while drag&drop a part over a box, right clicking would change the view to desired box but would also rotate the part which was unintended. Now it does not rotate anymore in this case.
When selecting a piece you would en up with one piece which was below (and hidden) the one you clicked on. Now with the new internal layer sytem, this should not happen anymore, allowing you to effectively select what you see and are clicking on.
Fixed some typos in puzzle descriptions.


To view all patch notes, heads here.

Happy puzzling!
